name: Dustin's Automotive
hook: Your customers on Glendale Avenue bring the diesel pickup and the classic sedan to the same three bays — the ones still searching for a shop in Sparks could see those bays, your hours and a booking button on a page of your own. We built a trial version of that page. Take a look:
fakt: you've been running Dustin's Automotive on Glendale Avenue since 2014 as a full-service shop for gas and diesel vehicles, from diagnostics and check-engine-light repairs to timing belts, head gaskets, clutches and transmission work
na_stronie: your name, phone, e-mail and the Glendale Avenue address up front, your services exactly as you list them (diagnostic and troubleshooting, engine management incl. timing belts and head gaskets, transmission service and repair, clutch replacement, brakes, electrical repair, check-engine-light repairs, front end and suspension), weekday hours 9–6, online booking and a contact form that lands in your inbox, and your own photos of the building, the sign and the trucks on the lifts
dlaczego: People looking for a diesel-capable independent in Sparks search on their phone and skip anything that has no page. A site of your own with the bays, the list and a booking button is the difference between being found and being scrolled past.
